title: Clear Hotbar
description: This Resource Pack adds a simple black transparent hotbar whilst maintaining Vanilla Minecraft Looks!
body: Clear Simple Hotbar is a minimalist Minecraft resource pack designed to give your game a cleaner and less distracting user interface. By simplifying the hotbar and reducing unnecessary visual clutter, it helps keep your focus on the world around you while preserving Minecraft's iconic style. Perfect for survival, creative building, PvP, and content creation, this pack offers a sleek and modern look without changing gameplay or affecting performance. Enjoy a more open screen, improved visibility, and a polished aesthetic that blends seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft. Whether you're exploring, building, or recording videos, Clear Simple Hotbar provides a subtle but noticeable improvement to your overall experience.
